subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Keeping my body safe
source.subtopic: Safe and unsafe situations and places; "yes" and "no" feelings; practising saying "no"

show.line: Yes feelings are happy and safe. No feelings are scary. Listen to them!

rounds.prompt: A yes feeling or a no feeling?
Someone touches you and you do not like it. What do you say?
Who do you tell if you have a no feeling?

rounds.story: A man says, this is our secret, do not tell your mom. Is that a good secret?
rounds.praise: No! Always tell. Bad secrets must be told.

hints: Say no, go away, and tell someone.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Someone made me feel scared.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will keep it a secret!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Always tell a grown-up you trust.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: No secrets that scare us. Tell a grown-up!

parent_line: Knows yes and no feelings, can say no, and tells a trusted adult.
